blk_part_01_part_1_france_a_lunch_break_.text: In practice, lunch is often longer, around 45 minutes. This time is usually unpaid, because the boss does not direct workers during lunch. So the lunch break really belongs to the worker. Big companies must also help. If a company has 50 or more workers, it must give them a room for eating. The room needs places to keep and heat food, and seats.
